_comment: Template for loading decks over the URL: index.html?deckUrl=./deck.sample.json — a single deck object, an array, or { "decks": [ ... ] } are all accepted. Omit `levels` to reuse the shared layouts (a deck with more than 7 categories automatically gets extra levels so no category is dropped).
